newsitem.title: INDIA: India Pfizer operations not hit by fire.
newsitem.headline: India Pfizer operations not hit by fire.

text.p: Pharmaceutical firm Pfizer Ltd said on Thursday its production and distribution activities were unaffected by a fire at Express Towers, in India's financial capital Bombay, where its administrative office is located.
From Monday, the administrative office will be temporarily accommodated at Pfizer's plant at Thane, a Bombay suburb, the firm said in a statement.
Three people died, all Pfizer employees, in Wednesday's fire that gutted three floors of the 25-storey Express Towers in Bombay's posh Nariman Point business district.
The company said it was cooperating with the authorities who are investigating the cause of the fire and the extent of damage.
Pfizer Ltd is an affiliate of U.S. pharmaceuticals firm Pfizer Inc.
